hederaTestnet.note: Agent identity is HCS-14-style (uaid:aid:hedera:testnet:0.0.x) published to the registry topic via the Hedera Agent Kit; staking/slash is native-HBAR escrow via the Hedera SDK. Reputation is an HTS ReputationBond token (bondToken, set by `pnpm setup-hts`) with a custom fractional fee + freeze/pause/wipe compliance controls; on fraud the verifier freezes it and executes a multi-sig scheduled wipe via the Hedera Schedule Service. No Solidity anywhere — HCS + HTS + Schedule + Mirror Node, all SDK-native.
